title: TAT-3344 — prove the max order amount is placeable
description: Derive a max order amount through the changed getMaxAllowedAmount against live account state, then submit that exact amount as a real market order on HyperLiquid testnet. A fixed-notional order proves nothing here: the defect is in how the maximum is SIZED, so the size under test must come from the changed function. mode=fixed expects the order to be accepted; mode=prefix recomputes the pre-fix formula from the same live inputs and expects the venue to refuse it, which is the TAT-3344 report reproduced live.

network.description: Testnet only. This proof spends the entire spendable balance as margin and must never touch real funds.

leverage.description: Order leverage; also fed to getMaxAllowedAmount.

mode.description: fixed = current getMaxAllowedAmount result. prefix = pre-fix formula on the same live inputs.

expected_state.description: State the submission should produce. Use 'none' with expect_error.

expect_error.description: Exact controller/venue error the submission must be refused with. Empty expects acceptance.

compute_out.description: Where the compute step writes its inputs/outputs record as evidence.

proofTargets.claim: The order amount submitted is the value getMaxAllowedAmount returned for the live spendable balance, price and szDecimals — not a fixed notional.
HyperLiquid accepts a max-size market buy sized by the fixed function, and refuses the same order sized by the pre-fix formula.

guard-testnet.intent: Refuse to run anywhere but testnet before any mutation

ensure-clean-market.intent: Start flat on {{params.market}} so the margin available to this order, and the state asserted after it, are attributable to this proof

compute-max.intent: Read live spendableBalance/price/szDecimals through the controller and size the max with getMaxAllowedAmount ({{params.mode}}); stdout is the amount

submit-max-order.intent: Submit the computed maximum as a real market buy. The amount becomes the provider's usdAmount, so size = usdAmount / mid while the order is priced at mid * (1 + slippage) — the mismatch TAT-3344 is about.

choose-state-assertion.intent: Assert the state this submission was expected to produce

assert-open-position.intent: The max-size buy actually opened a position, so the venue took it

assert-no-position.intent: The refused order left no position behind

restore-market.intent: Close or cancel whatever this proof placed, leaving the account flat
